# Malin Müller

I am a PhD candidate at the [RPTU Kaiserslautern-Landau](https://rptu.de/methodenzentrum/ueber-uns/team/malin-mueller) and an associated member of the
[Research Training Group Statistical Modeling in Psychology (SMiP)](https://www.uni-mannheim.de/smip/team/phd-candidates/cohort-2024/malin-mueller/).
I am interested in improving measurement in intensive longitudinal data (e.g., careless responding, response styles, and measurement reactivity). In my PhD, I investigate how careless responding can be detected and addressed in experience sampling studies using different mixture modeling approaches.
